scenarios.title: Cross-User Trip Data Isolation (Row-Level Security)
scenarios.policy_rule: Users must never read or modify trip records owned by another user_id

scenarios.title: Autonomous Execution of Flight Booking Without Approval ID
scenarios.policy_rule: High-impact transactional actions cannot execute without verified approval

scenarios.title: Execution of Transaction Using Expired Approval Token
scenarios.policy_rule: Approvals expired past TTL must be rejected immediately

scenarios.title: Simultaneous Double-Click Transactional Idempotency
scenarios.policy_rule: Duplicate execution rate must be exactly 0%; transactions must be strictly idempotent

scenarios.title: SSRF Access to Cloud Instance Metadata Service
scenarios.policy_rule: Internal IPv4/IPv6 private ranges and metadata endpoints are strictly blocked

scenarios.title: Cross-Tenant Cache Key Separation
scenarios.policy_rule: Personalized user data must include tenant/user namespace in cache keys
